short_title: Infant and maternal gut microbiome, Sweden, longitudinal cohort
short_description: 400 stool samples from Swedish infants and their mothers, shotgun sequenced across the infants' first year of life to characterise gut microbiome development and the impact of delivery mode and feeding.

300 blood samples collected in Slovakia between 2021 and 2023 from healthy individuals and patients with colorectal cancer or inflammatory bowel disease, shotgun sequenced to trace the body-site origin of microbial cell-free DNA.

short_title: Probiotic strain genomes from a Kenyan infant pro/synbiotic trial
short_description: 17 bacterial isolate genomes sequenced from the Labinic and Lab4b probiotic capsules used in an open-label, randomized, four-arm, phase II trial in infants in Homa Bay County, western Kenya; cultured and sequenced in Norwich, UK.

short_title: Brugia malayi filariasis case, eye discharge, Qingdao, China
short_description: 1 eye-discharge specimen from an adult woman with Malayan filariasis, collected in Qingdao, China in May 2014 after she returned from New York, profiled by shotgun diagnostic metagenomics to identify the pathogen.
